description: Honestly some of the best cookies I’ve ever made.  chocolate chip cookies recipe ingredients: 	 * 1 cup + 2 tbsp unsalted butter  * 1 cup light brown sugar * 1/2 cup granulated sugar * 2 eggs, at room temp * 2 tsp vanilla bean paste * 2 3/4 cups all-purpose flour * 3/4 tsp baking soda * 1/2 tsp salt * 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips & some chopped chocolate  instructions:  1. add the butter into a saucepan over medium-high heat. allow it to melt and brown ~ should take around 5-8 minutes. set it aside to cool for 15 min 2. in a medium bowl whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt. set it aside 3. once the brown butter has cooled, add both sugars and whisk until combined.  4. add in the eggs and whisk until combined. whisk in the vanilla.  5. add the dry ingredients to the wet, and fold with a spatula until barely combined.  6. add in your chocolate chips/chunks 7. use a large cookie scoop to scoop the dough onto a prepared baking sheet. 8. cover the sheet with plastic wrap and place in the freezer for 15 minutes.  9. preheat the oven to 350 F 10. once ready to bake, bake them at 350F for 14 minutes. 11. allow them to cool and then enjoy :)  #cookie #cookies #icecream #baking #cookierecipe
